title: Enabling Modern Plan Designs - Amera - AI-Powered Claims Processing Automation for Healthcare
summary: Amera supports a wide range of new payment models that enable better care and faster payment for providers
body_markdown:
New payment models promise better care and faster payment for physicians. But operational complexity has kept most TPAs and health plans from adopting them.


Amera removes that barrier. We now handle the claims data infrastructure for:


→ Reference-Based Pricing Plans
→ Direct Contracting
→ Cash-Pay Plans
→ Complex Network Design


In 2026, TPAs need to support innovative plans to retain and win employer groups. With Amera, you're set up in two weeks: no new staff, no new infrastructure, no onboarding fees.
